findings: Two separate ruled header-plus-three-row tables remain on one portrait page.
Planning and Delivery headings distinguish the tables; complete prose is visible before, between and after both.
Repeated Review service descriptions retain distinct row IDs and amounts. No clipping or overlap is visible.
Two separate ruled tables remain on one portrait page.
The long research description wraps inside the first table and the long delivery description wraps inside the second; each remains with its own ID, quantity and amount.
The complete separating paragraph and final paragraph are readable; rules do not touch or clip text.
Both distinct ruled tables fit on one landscape page with ample whitespace below the final paragraph.
The full inter-table paragraph lies in a substantial open gap; IDs and amounts remain clearly associated with each row.
No clipping, table spillover or extra page is visible.
Two titled reference-note groups are visibly borderless, with tab-aligned amounts and no table ruling.
The complete paragraph between note groups is visible, as are the opening and final paragraphs.
All six reference/amount lines are readable in the intended group order.

limitations: Source validity does not establish conversion quality.
This is agent visual inspection, not human sign-off.
